# Hongguo runtime snapshot

Source: https://github.com/tztmr/hongguo-download

Revision: `7758098e83ed24e01ac0ed4631fd3e2081870048`

Only the Python modules imported by TACO小剧场 are included. No desktop app, local configuration, device pool, account database, proxy credentials, or media files are copied. The runtime modules are unchanged from the recorded revision. `manifest.json` records SHA-256 hashes for verification.

Updates should copy the required modules from a reviewed source revision and rerun the website tests and Docker build. This snapshot is distributed within the same owner's private repository; it does not grant additional rights to the upstream code.
